messages.content: How is the air quality in Los Angeles right now?

function.name: plant_biomass
function.description: Calculate the biomass of a plant species in a given area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data on air quality, but you can quickly check the current conditions in Los Angeles by visiting one of the following resources:

| Source | What it offers | How to use |
|--------|----------------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Current AQI, pollutant levels, forecast | Go to https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **BreezoMeter** | Real‑time AQI, health recommendations | Visit https://www.breezometer.com/, search for Los Angeles. |
| **Weather.com** | AQI, forecast, health tips | Search “Los Angeles AQI” on https://weather.com. |
| **Local news sites** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) | Live updates, alerts | Check their weather or environment sections. |

If you’d like a quick snapshot right now, you can also use a voice assistant (Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa) and say “What’s the air quality in Los Angeles?” They pull the latest data from the EPA or other partners.
